question.text: A closely wounded circular coil of radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> produces a magnetic field of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>37</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>68</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math> at its center. The current through the coil is _____  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>. [Given, number of turns in the coil is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>π</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>14</mn></math>]

solution.text:
Given here, N=100, R=5 cm and B=37.68×10-4 T

Magnetic field at the centre of circular coil is given by Bcentre =Nμ0l2R.

Putting the values, 

37.68×10-4=100×4π×10-7×I2×5×10-2

Current through coil is I=3 A.
